levels.name: Aware
levels.definition: Has access to approved AI tools and knows what they are for; no regular use yet

levels.name: Exploring
levels.definition: Uses AI occasionally for isolated, low-risk tasks

levels.name: Practicing
levels.definition: Uses AI weekly on a recurring set of core role tasks and verifies output

levels.name: Proficient
levels.definition: Uses AI daily across most core tasks, with deliberate prompting, context files, and reusable patterns

levels.name: Advanced
levels.definition: Runs multi-step and agentic workflows, connects AI to tools and data, and delegates scoped work to agents

levels.name: Multiplier
levels.definition: Builds shared AI assets others use, sets practices and guardrails, coaches others

levels.name: Transformer
levels.definition: Redesigns a process or role end to end around AI and builds organization-wide capability

1: No access, and not familiar with the approved AI tools
Familiar with the approved tools, but no access yet
Have access and have tried the tools
Have access, set up, and familiar with the AI usage policy
2: Daily, as part of most tasks
3: Daily, as part of most tasks
4: Daily, as part of most tasks
5: Done a few times, with close review
Do it regularly, with a verification step
Routine, using reusable commands, connectors, or workflows
6: Created it, used only by me so far
Shared it, and at least 2 colleagues use it
Adopted as a team standard or practice
7: Adopted by my team, with measured results
Adopted beyond my team or organization-wide, with measured results
